concerns.text: The plan relies on a fully synthetic dataset because no verified ACE SWICS or NOAA Dst/Kp data exist. While the synthetic data are useful for pipeline validation, they cannot provide evidence for the scientific hypothesis that solar‑wind composition independently predicts geomagnetic storm intensity. Claiming to “explore the statistical relationship” with synthetic data violates construct validity and causal inference – the results will not generalize to real observations.

The success criteria use an arbitrary ΔR² > 0.05 threshold and a permutation‑p < 0.05 rule without any power analysis or justification of detectable effect size. There is no discussion of the minimum composition effect size that the 20‑year hourly synthetic sample can reliably detect, making it unclear whether the planned sample size is sufficient to meet the scientific objectives.
